sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLETE DIRECT_CALCULATION contract: it targets longitudinalFrame, uses the authoritative owner for all operands and results, requires applicability selectors, enforces the conditional m=13.3 branch, computes f4, section modulus, required shear area, and actual shear area with bracket exclusion, and uses expected-result-scaled tolerances with permitted arithmetic and comparisons. Prior repair instructions are preserved and satisfied.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the direct-calculation query to use only registered arithmetic and comparisons: replace ABS-based tolerance checks with explicit expected-value lower/upper bounds using tolerances scaled from each expected result. Also encode the verified shear-area boundary explicitly: the A formula is the required/effective shear area, while actualFrameShearArea must exclude bracketArea; do not leave the bracket-exclusion requirement unrepresented. Remove the redundant sh:or alternative that is satisfied merely by frameMomentFactorM presence and instead enforce the conditional m=13.3 branch directly while requiring branch-selection applicability evidence.

Candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLETE DIRECT_CALCULATION contract: it targets longitudinalFrame, uses the authoritative owner for all operands and results, requires applicability selectors, enforces the conditional m=13.3 branch, computes f4, section modulus, required shear area, and actual shear area with bracket exclusion, and uses expected-result-scaled tolerances with permitted arithmetic and comparisons. Prior repair instructions are preserved and satisfied.
